transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, I've been having some trouble with eating lately. Like, on late work nights, I'll order what's supposed to be just dinner, but... it ends up being a lot. An entrée, sides, dessert, and then... extra snacks from the kitchen. It's... I don't know, it's just way more than I'd ever eat if someone were actually sitting across from me.
Do you feel guilty after eating all that food?
Yeah, I do. Um... I just feel really bad about it afterwards.
Do you usually eat all that extra food alone?

Yeah... pretty much always alone. Um... when I'm with coworkers or friends, I'm careful to just eat lightly. 

But... when I'm by myself in my condo, like after midnight... that's when it happens. I just... I'd be mortified if anyone saw how much food there was. I even close the blinds and... I try to get rid of the delivery containers really quickly so no one knows.
Do you do anything to try to get rid of the extra calories after you eat all that food?
No... I don't. Um... I just go to sleep eventually.
Do you usually eat this extra food when you're feeling stressed or upset?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't... I don't really pay attention to how I'm feeling right before. It just kind of happens.
How often do these late-night eating episodes happen?
Um... well, I guess... if I look back at my delivery receipts and stuff... it's usually at least one night a week. Sometimes more. And... it's been like that for a few months now, I think.
Do you feel like you can stop eating once you've started on those late nights?

Um... no. Not really. 

I guess... once I start, there's just this point where I'm kind of... watching myself. Like, I'll be opening another package, or clicking back to the food, and in my head I'm thinking I should stop, but... I don't know. It just feels like the decision has already slipped out of my hands.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after one of these eating episodes?
Um... no. I've never... I don't do that.
Do you feel like you're in control of how much you're eating during those late nights?
Um... no. Like I just said... it's like I'm just watching myself do it. I know I'm eating a lot, and I think about stopping, but... I just can't. It's out of my hands.
Do you feel like you're eating much more quickly than usual during those late nights?

Um... yeah. I guess I do. 

When I'm at my desk... I usually have my Illustrator files open, and... I just kind of move from one container to the next. I don't really even notice the taste. It's just... I realize after a few minutes that I've already swallowed most of it.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop yourself from continuing to eat during those late nights?
Um... yeah. I mean, like I said a minute ago... I just can't. Once I start, I don't really know how to stop.
